title: Slow English Podcast #319: Rothenburg ob der Tauber - Germany

sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the slow English podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast, we speak slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words.
Today, we travel to Germany. Our city today is Rothenburg up there, Talber. This city is small. This city is very old. This city feels like the past.
Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let us begin. Part two, Germany in simple words. Germany is in Europe. It has history and order.
Cities feel clean. Life feels planned. People respect time. People respect rules. Rothenburg shows old Germany.
Part three, where is Rothenburg? Rothenburg up there, Talber is in southern Germany. It is not near big cities. Nature is around it.
Fields and trees feel close. The town feels quiet. The town feels safe. Part four, a town frozen in time. Rothenburg is very old. Many houses are medieval.
The town did not change much. The past stays alive. Walking here feels different. Time feels slow. Part five, city walls and gates. The town has walls.
The walls are strong. You can walk on them. You can see the whole town. Gates protect the city. History feels close. Part six, streets and half-timbered houses.
Houses are wooden. Walls have patterns. Roofs are red. Windows are small. Every street looks special. Every corner feels like a photo.
Part seven, daily life in the town. People live calmly. They know each other. Shops are small. Cafes feel warm. Life is simple. Life is quiet. Part eight, food and German taste.
Food is warm and filling. Bread is important. Soups are popular. Meals feel strong. Eating feels comforting. Food brings energy. Part nine, seasons in Rothenburg. Winter feels magical.

Snow covers the town. Summer feels bright. Flowers are everywhere. Each season changes the feeling. Each season feels special. Part ten, culture and traditions. Traditions are strong here. Festivals happen every year.
People wear old clothes. Music fills the streets. Culture lives naturally. The past is honored. Part eleven, silence and peace.
The town is quiet. Noise is rare. People walk slowly. They enjoy silence. The mind relaxes. The heart feels calm.
Part twelve, the soul of Rothenburg and goodbye. Rothenburg is calm. Rothenburg is historic. It is small but deep. It is quiet but full.
